name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3742: Review-after-ship batch on v3740 and v3741 (REG-2240; board #108 #11 #134 #137 #14 #44): planner copy-undo is now scoped to the bumped name not just the token, so a re-roll of a later pick can no longer revert the first picks copy; the set-dupe migration stamps itself done only after a CONFIRMED owned-persist, so a failed write retries instead of stranding a stray under a done-stamp; a fullscreen dupes window holding only shared spare copies no longer also says empty locker; the shared-tab overflow note tells the truth (a shared tab is 100 cells with no auto-spill) instead of calling it a 10x10 preview; the floating item card tracks its item through a mouse-less wheel or keyboard scroll; and leaving the theatre dismisses the floating item tooltip it spawned. HEART: each fix ships a RED-first guard — five Routine-I spec.ts plus the node gate test_a_closed_theatre_dismisses_the_item_tooltip, and the REG-2231 red-proof in test_the_mule_inventory is re-anchored to the new guard line.
